description: Soak Up the Rain is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA Region 1 (New England). This public outreach campaign offers information on using green infrastructure to manage stormwater runoff. The campaign encourages action by citizens, municipalities, and local organizations to reduce polluted runoff. The campaign promotes installations of rain barrels, downspout redirection, rain gardens, tree planting, permeable surfaces, and green roofs that can help reduce runoff. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Water Quality. Assets: Cultural and Community Services, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
